market_overview: Across the evidence packet, bullish sentiment dominates in commodities and equities, with the global PSI at 57 indicating mixed/neutral market mood. Bitcoin, gold and oil show bullish consensus despite some conflicting coverage, while AI, U.S. equities, inflation and rates hover around mixed/neutral with high confidence but divergent directional balances. The U.S. dollar remains bullish overall but with low confidence and notable conflict. Across topics, geopolitics, currency moves and supply disruptions are recurring themes, creating both alignment and tension in market narratives.
